message:
We all have that one friend who panics at the slightest hint of trouble, right? We love them dearly, but sometimes their energy can be a bit overwhelming. Recently, when a storm warning popped up, our friend was frantically texting us about their go-bag and water supply. It got us thinking—while we might not need to go into full panic mode, it’s a good reminder to check in on our own preparedness plans. 

So, we took a moment to gather our essentials and review our emergency contacts. It felt refreshing to have a little peace of mind. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying calm and ready when life throws a curveball?
